# Support

For setup and usage help, start with the [project README](../README.md) and
[documentation index](../docs/README.md). Common operational failures and safe recovery steps
are covered in [troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

If the documentation doesn't resolve the problem, open the matching GitHub issue form. Share
the relevant configuration, commands, logs, expected result, and actual result after removing
tokens, credentials, private hostnames, personal data, and other secrets.

Keep vulnerabilities and sensitive security findings out of public issues. Report them
privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Schweinhitti/auto-opsi-repo/security/advisories/new).
